spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(cancellation) * 100, 2) AS cancellation_rate
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(utilization_pct), 2) AS utilization
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY utilization DESC;

SELECT
    e.city,
    e.country,

    CASE
        WHEN e.city = 'Delhi' THEN 28.613900
        WHEN e.city = 'Mumbai' THEN 19.076000
        WHEN e.city = 'Bangalore' THEN 12.971600
        WHEN e.city = 'Dubai' THEN 25.204800
        WHEN e.city = 'Abu Dhabi' THEN 24.453900
        WHEN e.city = 'Singapore' THEN 1.352100
        WHEN e.city = 'Bangkok' THEN 13.756300
        WHEN e.city = 'Jakarta' THEN -6.208800
        WHEN e.city = 'Kuala Lumpur' THEN 3.139000
    END AS latitude,

    CASE
        WHEN e.city = 'Delhi' THEN 77.209000
        WHEN e.city = 'Mumbai' THEN 72.877700
        WHEN e.city = 'Bangalore' THEN 77.594600
        WHEN e.city = 'Dubai' THEN 55.270800
        WHEN e.city = 'Abu Dhabi' THEN 54.377300
        WHEN e.city = 'Singapore' THEN 103.819800
        WHEN e.city = 'Bangkok' THEN 100.501800
        WHEN e.city = 'Jakarta' THEN 106.845600
        WHEN e.city = 'Kuala Lumpur' THEN 101.686900
    END AS longitude,

    ROUND(AVG(e.demand), 2) AS demand,

    ROUND(AVG(e.available_drivers), 2) AS supply,

    ROUND(AVG(e.demand_supply_gap), 2) AS demand_supply_gap,

    ROUND(AVG(e.eta_minutes), 2) AS average_eta,

    ROUND(AVG(e.cancellation) * 100, 2) AS cancellation_rate,

    ROUND(SUM(e.revenue), 2) AS total_revenue

FROM mobility_events e

GROUP BY
    e.city,
    e.country

ORDER BY demand DESC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(demand), 2) AS average_demand
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY average_demand DESC;

SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(available_drivers), 2) AS average_supply
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY average_supply DESC;

spec.title: Demand-Supply Gap by City
spec.description:
Positive gap = shortage

Negative gap = excess supply

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(demand_supply_gap), 2) AS average_gap
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY average_gap DESC;

spec.title: Average Customer ETA by City
spec.description: Higher ETA indicates operational pressure and potentially weaker customer experience.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    city,
    ROUND(AVG(eta_minutes), 2) AS average_eta
FROM mobility_events
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY average_eta DESC;
